landing.title: Legal Terminal
landing.subtitle: Pick a case to open in the terminal, or create a new one.
landing.searchPlaceholder: Search by case name or party...
landing.createCase: Create a case for the terminal
landing.emptyHint: Create a case to start a terminal workspace.

renameLayoutKeys: Enter to save · Esc to cancel
deleteLayoutBody: “{{name}}” and its pane arrangement will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
presetQuickReviewDesc: Case summary only — a single focused pane.
presetEvidenceCheckDesc: Case summary and evidence side by side.
presetCaseWorkspaceDesc: Case summary, evidence, chat, and procedure in one workspace.
presetFullResearchDesc: Case summary, evidence, law, mind map, procedure, and chat together.
presetClientCallDesc: Case summary and AI assistant, ready for a client call.
presetDepositionPrepDesc: Witnesses, contradictions, and red team review in one view.
presetDeadlineTrackerDesc: Case strategy and decision records, for tracking what's due.
presetAppealReviewDesc: Legal issues, strengths, and weaknesses — a quick appeal viability check.
emptyLayoutDescription: Create a workspace to start arranging your legal tools.
replacePanePrompt: The board is full — pick a pane to replace
noUnpinnedPanes: Every visible pane is pinned — unpin one to make room.
multiScreenAvailable: Multi-screen available — pop a pane out to send it to another screen
screenPresetsHint: Apply a preset to arrange panels across every connected screen in one click.
presetTrialPrepDesc: Case summary and evidence on the primary screen; law and strategy panels on the second.
presetDocumentReviewDesc: Evidence and contradictions on the primary screen; witnesses, damages, and procedure on the second.
presetResearchDeepDiveDesc: Case summary and law on the primary screen; every argument and citation panel on the second.
presetFullWorkspaceDesc: Case summary on the primary screen, evidence on the second, and strategy and damages on the third.
presetTrialDayDesc: Case summary on the primary screen, evidence and witnesses on the second, and courtroom arguments on the third.
presetStrategySessionDesc: Case summary on the primary screen, strategy mapping on the second, and law and damages on the third.
presetSpreadEvenlyDesc: Every panel divided evenly across all connected screens.
presetClientIntakeDesc: First case review — case summary and evidence on the primary screen, initial procedure checklist on the second.
presetWitnessPrepDesc: Witness credibility and prep — case summary and witnesses on the primary screen, contradictions and red team review on the second.
presetClientReportingDesc: Status updates — case summary on the primary screen, decision records and strategy map on the second.
presetDepositionDayDesc: Witness prep on the primary screen, contradictions and attack strategy on the second.
presetDiscoveryReviewDesc: Evidence and contradictions on the primary screen, procedure and team audit on the second.
presetAppealPrepDesc: Case summary and legal issues on the primary screen, citations and case strength on the second.
presetMediationSessionDesc: Case summary and damages on the primary screen, theories and decisions on the second.
presetMotionDraftingDesc: Drafting motions — case summary and procedure on the primary screen, law and citations on the second, decisions and legal issues on the third.
presetSettlementPrepDesc: Settlement and mediation — case summary and damages on the primary screen, witnesses and theories on the second, decisions and procedure on the third.
presetCrossExamPrepDesc: Cross-examination — case summary on the primary screen, witnesses and contradictions on the second, attack and defense strategies on the third.
presetDepositionPrepSuiteDesc: Case summary on the primary screen, witnesses and contradictions on the second, attack and defense strategy on the third.
presetAppealStrategyDesc: Case summary and procedure on the primary screen, law and citations on the second, case strength and decisions on the third.
presetDiscoveryCommandDesc: Case summary on the primary screen, evidence and witnesses on the second, procedure and case reconstruction on the third.
presetFactVerificationDesc: Case summary on the primary screen, evidence and fact verification on the second, witnesses and case reconstruction on the third.
presetWarRoomDesc: Full trial team setup — case summary on the primary screen, evidence and witnesses on the second, courtroom arguments on the third, and damages and decisions on the fourth.
presetComplexLitigationDesc: Multi-front case — case summary on the primary screen, evidence and procedure on the second, law and issues on the third, and case strength analysis on the fourth.
presetFullTeamAuditDesc: Team-wide review — case summary on the primary screen, witnesses and team audit on the second, risk analysis on the third, and damages and reconstruction on the fourth.
reopenScreensBanner: {{count}} panels are on other screens — reopen them
removePaneHint: To remove it, use the × on the pane itself
emptyGrid: No panes on the grid — open Workspace Settings to add one.
paneUpdating: Updating — new content is on its way
dragHint: Drag the title bar to move this pane. Drag any edge or corner to resize. Other panes stay put.
resizePane: Resize pane. Use arrow keys to resize.
resizePaneFitHint: Resize pane. Use arrow keys to resize. Double-click or press Enter to fit height to content.
resizeColumns: Resize columns. Use left/right arrow keys.
resizeColumnStack: Resize stacked panes. Use up/down arrow keys.
resizeTabGroups: Resize panes. Use left/right arrow keys.
fatalBanner: Fatal risks are open on this case.
outlookEmptyHint: An assessment appears the next time a document is added or updated on this case.
contradictionResolveHint: A real conflict you have explained or dealt with
contradictionsIntro: Statements in the record that conflict on a material fact.
noAuthorities: No authority cited for this case's grounds yet.
authorityStanceLabel: How it bears on the case
noDates: Dates extracted from the documents appear here automatically, or link a calendar event.
emptyFolder: Drop files here, or use Add above.
noApproach: A recommended approach appears automatically once the case's analysis updates.
noTodos: To-dos appear automatically once the case's analysis updates, or add one below.
chatEmptySubheading: The assistant stays in this pane.
removeDocumentConfirm: Remove "{{documentName}}" from this case? This cannot be undone.
noFindings: Nothing recorded yet. Add one below — suggestions appear automatically once the case's analysis updates.
groundsIntro: How each authority attaches to a pleaded ground.
groundsNeedClaims: Add or find the case's claims first.
groundsNoAuthorities: No cited authorities yet. Citations added in Law & Precedent appear here.
claimsEmpty: No claims yet. Find them in the pleadings, or add one.
sweepNotRun: Not yet run against any ground
sweepSummary: Swept {{date}} · {{inCorpus}} of {{total}} authorities in the indexed corpus
sweepScope: Only later decisions already in the indexed corpus are found — a clear sweep isn't a guarantee the authority is still good law.
sweepNoHits: No adverse treatment found in the indexed corpus.
sweepOwnStatus: your citation check found its text undermines what it's cited for

sweepJev.NOT_ADVERSE: Doesn't touch what it's cited for

legalIssuesIntro: Open questions the tribunal will have to reach.
issueDetailPlaceholder: Who bears the burden, and on what
findingJevOff: Jev checks for this panel are turned off.
findingJevFailed: Jev couldn't check this. Try again.
issueJevBurdenDisputed: The AI draft put it on {{party}}.
llmUncertain: The AI was unsure — read the reasoning before relying on it.
llmNotReviewed: Not reviewed (the AI review failed) — this is the AI draft's rating.
llmOff: AI review is turned off for this panel.
llmFailed: The AI review couldn't run. Try again.

strengthWeightLevel.3: Carries a claim on its own

issueJevFlag.NOT_RAISED: Not found in the case data
issueJevFlag.BURDEN_DISPUTED: Burden may sit with the other side

weaknessesIntro: Exposure in our own case, ordered by how early it will surface.
weaknessImpact: Expected impact on the case (positive hurts you)

weaknessJevSupport.SUPPORTED: Borne out by the case data
weaknessJevSupport.UNSUPPORTED: Not borne out by the case data

weaknessJevCurable.NOT_CURABLE: Nothing on the record would close it

weaknessJevFlag.NOT_BORNE_OUT: Not borne out by the case data

strengthsIntro: Findings that carry our theory of the case.
strengthDetailPlaceholder: Document reference and what it shows
strengthImpact: How much of the case it carries (higher helps you)
strengthJevNoSourceText: (checked against the case data only — the document's text wasn't found)

strengthJevRebuttal.UNREBUTTED: Nothing on the record answers it
strengthJevRebuttal.REBUTTABLE: The other side has an answer you'd need to meet

attackStrategyIntro: Offensive moves to advance this case, whichever side we represent.
attackStrategyDetailPlaceholder: Why it's ready, what's left, or what's missing
defenseStrategyIntro: Defenses the other side is likely to raise against this case, and our answer to each.
defenseStrategyDetailPlaceholder: This case's answer to the defense
witnessesIntro: Statement status for the custodians named in the complaint.
witnessFactorQuoteMissing: quote not found in the document
witnessProofPrompt: Attach a document or photo from Documents that shows this was done.
witnessProofDocGone: a document no longer in Documents
witnessNotReflected: Not yet reflected in the score. Rescore to check.
witnessExtracting: Finding witnesses in your case documents…
damagesNoteProvisional: Preliminary model. Figures stay provisional until the {{evidence}} lands.
damagesNoteProvisionalGeneric: Preliminary model. Some figures are still provisional.
damagesRangeUnset: No range set yet. Give a head a low or high figure to see how far the claim could swing.
damageLabelHint: Shown instead of the category, e.g. "Actual (backwages)"
damagePreviewIncomplete: Fill in the inputs to see the amount
damageRangeHint: Leave blank to use the amount
damageRangeInvalid: The low figure can't be above the high figure.
damagePendingEvidenceHint: What would firm this figure up, e.g. "payroll certification"
damagesProposeHint: Read every document of this case again and propose heads with a figure in them. Heads already here are kept.
damageAcceptHint: Mark this AI-proposed head as supported by its document
damageNoPeriod: Not in the total yet: this monthly rate needs a period, such as from the dismissal date, accruing to today.
damageSetPeriodAcceptHint: Add how long this rate runs so it counts in the total, and accept it
damageEditorAcceptHint: Add the period this rate runs for; saving also accepts the head.
damageSourceDocGone: Document no longer in this case
damageBasisRateAccruing: {{rate}} a month since {{from}}, accruing to today ({{months}} months)
damageAccruing: Keeps accruing to today (backwages run until the decision is final)
damageHighUntilDateHint: Sets the high end of the range if the case runs this long
damageProposalTitle: Suggested update from a new document
damageProposalConfirms: {{doc}} looks like the {{evidence}} this figure was waiting on, and it confirms the figure.
damageProposalIsEvidence: It also looks like the {{evidence}} this figure was waiting on.
noWitnessesForSponsor: Add a witness in the Witnesses panel to assign a sponsor.
noReconstruction: No reconstruction yet — generate one from this case's indexed documents.
registerNotGenerated: Not generated yet — switch to General and Generate to create this version.
audioOutOfDate: Narrative changed since this audio was generated.
noRedTeam: No assessment yet — generate one from this case's Legal Issues, Weaknesses, Contradictions, Witnesses, and Damages.
redTeamArgumentsIntro: Best arguments available to {{opponent}}, ranked by expected impact.
redTeamArgumentsIntroNoParty: Best arguments available to the other side, ranked by expected impact.
redTeamImpact: Expected impact on the case (positive hurts you)
jevUncertain: Jev was unsure about this rating — read the reasoning before relying on it.
jevNotChecked: Not checked by Jev (the check failed) — this rating is the drafting AI's own.

redTeamJevSupport.SUPPORTED: the cited item supports this argument
redTeamJevSupport.UNSUPPORTED: the cited item does not establish this argument
redTeamJevSupport.CONTRADICTED: the cited item contradicts this argument

panelLibraryHint: Drag a panel onto the grid, or click to add it.
panelLibraryEmpty: All panels are already on the grid.
noDecisions: No decisions recorded yet — these populate automatically as the case's legal chat produces answers with clear conclusions.
noTheories: No theories yet — write one, or have the AI propose a starting point from this case's findings.
addClaimPlaceholder: Add a claim this theory asserts or denies
addAssumptionPlaceholder: Add an assumption this theory rests on
deleteForkedTheoryConfirm: Delete this forked theory? Its claims, assumptions, open questions and notes go with it. The original is kept.
noDiffFound: No shared or divergent claims found between these two theories.
noEvents: No event chain yet — generate the case's dated events from its documents.
eventsBlockedIntro: The event chain can't be built yet:
noScenes: No scenes yet — generate a scene-by-scene break of this case's most consequential episode from the timeline and evidence.
noTableRead: No table read yet — generate scenes first, then render a multi-voice reading of them.
tableReadOutOfDate: Scenes changed since this table read was generated.
noExhibitsForScene: No verified exhibits for this scene.
caseBriefGenerateHint: Generate a Word and PDF version of this case's brief from its current snapshot.
caseBriefRegenerateHint: Generate a fresh Word and PDF version from this case's current snapshot. Your previous briefs stay in History.
caseBriefNothingGenerated: No case brief generated yet — go to Generate first.
caseBriefFormatNotGenerated: This format hasn't been generated yet.
groundingLoading: Checking this case's answers against the bundle…
groundingEmpty: Nothing checked yet. Verification runs automatically on legal chat turns in a case once it is enabled — an empty panel does not mean the answers are sound.
groundingNoProblems: Nothing to act on. All {{count}} checked claims held up against the bundle.

groundingVerdict.FALSE_ABSENCE: Said to be missing, but supplied
groundingVerdict.UNSUPPORTED: Not established by the cited document
groundingVerdict.NOT_SUPPLIED: Not sent to the AI for this answer
groundingVerdict.CORRECT_ABSENCE: Correctly flagged as not in the bundle

groundingEvidenceKind.ASSERTED_BY_PARTY: The passage records a party's assertion, not a finding
groundingEvidenceKind.STATED_BY_WITNESS: The passage is a witness's account

authorityCitationHint: Optional. We'll link the source when the citation can be found.
authorityRationaleExample: How this helps or hurts the ground
quoteExample: Paste the passage you're relying on
citedReferenceHint: Optional. Helps us find the source and link it.
officialTextExample: Paste the source passage to compare against
officialTextHint: Optional. Lets us check that your quote matches the source.
strategyStale: The case changed {{count}} time(s) since this plan was updated.
strategyStaleOne: The case changed since this plan was updated.
updatePlanFailed: The plan couldn't be updated. Try again.
recomputeSome: {{count}} couldn't be recomputed and still need attention.
approachUnsupported: Not backed by the case data
toChecklistHint: Add this as a to-do in Case Strategy
addedToChecklistHint: Already a to-do in Case Strategy. It ticks itself once this is settled.

todoAutoClosedReason.DAMAGE_EVIDENCE_IN: damage head no longer waiting on evidence

flagRiskHint: Record this in the risk register, marked unverified
